propositions: A model class configured with provider='bedrock' and a canonical versioned Bedrock model id (containing colon in version suffix like us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0) has its provider silently discarded because _resolve_target treats any colon as a provider separator

The bug causes downstream infer_provider to split on the first colon, returning a model-id fragment as the provider name, leading to 'unknown provider' errors that contradict the operator's explicit config
An explicitly configured provider argument is not checked first before scanning the model string for qualifiers, allowing colons in model ids to override the configured provider setting
The qualified/unqualified decision is implemented twice independently (in _resolve_target and infer_provider) using colon-based logic, enabling them to drift and fail in the same way
